messages:
alex: Kicking off progressive shift to v3.12.0. Plan: EU-west 5% -> wait 15m -> 25% -> 100% if green. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood.dev/releases/v3.12.0

deploy-bot: release v3.12.0 triggered (canary id: 4532). Target region: eu-west. Initial shift: 5% traffic.

maria: @alex pinned the rollout to EU first — are we keeping older version pinned for quick fallback? :thinking:

deploy-bot: shift complete: eu-west = 5% -> v3.12.0. Check metrics: https://metrics.redwood.internal/canary/4532

monitoring-bot: [ALERT] eu-west p50 latency +75% (baseline 85ms -> now 150ms) — correlated with canary id 4532. See: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alert/7892

sam: seeing spike in 502s and backend timeout errors from edge-proxy in eu-west. snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T02:12:34Z] proxy: route /generate -> 502 upstream timeout (kq=0)
```

shawn: recommend pause further shifting and roll the EU region back to v3.11 while we triage. Prefer regional rollback rather than global.

alex: Agreed. Hold further shifts. @maria can you pin eu-west back to v3.11 and backfill traffic? We'll open an incident in #incidents.

maria: Running command: `deployctl pin --region eu-west --version v3.11 --reason "canary latency spike"`

deploy-bot: action: pin executed. eu-west pinned -> v3.11. Initiating gradual backfill to 100% over 2min.

deploy-bot: backfill complete. eu-west traffic now 100% -> v3.11. Canary 4532 suspended.

monitoring-bot: Metrics back to baseline (p50 88ms). Errors dropping to normal.

shawn: Nice. We'll hold the rollout until root cause identified. I'll sync with infra and post RCA draft. @alex please update release notes with rollback note and planned next attempt timeframe.

alex: Will do. Updating release notes and scheduling a follow-up postmortem. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
